description: This file defines a singleton object StringUtils with utility functions join and split that operate on a custom LinkedList class, delegating work to JoinUtils and SplitUtils respectively.

classes.name: StringUtils
classes.description: A singleton object providing string manipulation utilities, including methods to join a LinkedList into a string and split a string into a LinkedList.

methods.name: join
methods.description: Joins elements of a LinkedList into a String using JoinUtils.

methods.name: split
methods.description: Splits a String into a LinkedList using SplitUtils.
